title: Federated mining method and system for multimodal data based on multiple security policies

pse.problem: The system aims to address security risks, such as data theft, illegal access, tampering, lack of transparency, and privacy disclosures in edge computing for multimodal data.
pse.solution_function: The system performs federated mining on multimodal data using a multi-security policy. It includes a multiple authentication mechanism, a generalized multimodal data feature fusion model based on a multi-head attention mechanism, and an adaptive perturbation mechanism based on cyclic correlation analysis and differential privacy. The federated learning framework serves as the data mining model for distributed data mining.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of multiple authentication components, a generalized multimodal data feature fusion model with a multi-head attention mechanism, an adaptive perturbation mechanism based on cyclic correlation analysis and differential privacy, and a federated learning framework as the data mining model.
pse.solution_implementation: The system operates in a distributed manner through the federated learning framework. The multiple authentication components authenticate nodes. The generalized multimodal data feature fusion model uses a multi-head attention mechanism to combine features from different modalities. The adaptive perturbation mechanism applies cyclic correlation analysis and differential privacy to protect data privacy. The stochastic gradient descent process is used in the machine learning process.
pse.effect: The system improves security by addressing privacy disclosures, reducing computational burden for model training and usage, and increasing efficiency. It also verifies the security of edge nodes, improving overall security and making it more suitable for practical applications.
